title: Parser for the .michi file format
body: Three passes: parse to an untyped tree, expand sweeps, lower to builder calls. Rules in docs/file-format.md. Load-time errors with file, line and the sweep binding.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: Decided 2026-10-08: hand-written lexer and recursive descent, zero dependencies. Passes: parse, resolve (data and ranges), expand (sweeps, labels), lower (builders, typing). Reserved words listed in docs/file-format.md. First error stops. Golden .sh files test parse and resolve; expand gets unit tests.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: Lexer and parser written in michi-cli/src: error.rs, lex.rs, ast.rs, parse.rs, with unit tests and an integration test parsing syntax.michi. Workspace set up, root crate unchanged. Resolve, expand, lower and the .sh generator remain.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: Review fixes applied 2026-10-08. Left for later passes: resolve must reject a file with no pipeline and a $N inside a list literal in a parameter list; the scanner does not understand bash's $'…' quoting, accepted. Parser now takes trailing commas everywhere, spans cover the delimiters, and a command's first word is only a keyword when followed by whitespace, { or <.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: The design document docs/file-format.md is removed. The design is the set of notes on milestone michi-f12a47. Workspace restructured: the library is michi/, the binary michi-cli/.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: Resolve pass written (resolve.rs): ranges evaluated with the float rendering rule, data references and parameter lists checked, duplicate blocks and keys, tuple shapes, sweep variables in attribute arguments. Script generator written (sh.rs) and matches the hand-compiled syntax.sh byte for byte. Golden harness in tests/golden.rs with two cases, syntax and shapes, and a bash -n check. Expand and lower remain.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: Second review applied: comment injection, loop index clobbering, raw string references, data hoisting, data in sweeps rejected, inheritance through nested sweeps, range direction and float rendering, literal-only lists, flattened-name collisions, reserved _ names, sweep attributes seeing their own variables, harness ordering and missing-script messages.
